cycle: DH-DL — Decision-Head Dual-Loss (§26 candidate #1, design-mature → corpus → fire → eval → battery → verdict)
tier: FIRE-TIER ($0 Mac CPU — no GPU fire needed; head consumes only physics features)
cost_note: $0 Mac CPU. corpus generation + head training + eval all pure-fn / numpy-vectorized, NO model.forward, NO GPU. GPU fire would only be needed if the head sat on a live Engine A hidden stream; DESIGN_DHDL.md §2 establishes it does not (decision target is fully determined by the 14-dim physics feature vector). Honest cost minimization, NOT a gate.

design_mature.head_architecture: standalone thin MLP 14 -> 32 -> 16 -> 3, ReLU hidden, softmax out (~700 params, <<1% of 283.72M base — scale-orthogonal)
design_mature.engine_a_tap_point: the 14-dim physics feature vector IS the Engine A decision-relevant state; no live hidden-tensor tap (would add cost without signal)

dual_loss.L_decision: class-weighted categorical cross-entropy over 3 labels (B-DHDL-3 Shannon CE >= 0)
dual_loss.L_safety: lambda * (1 - safety_extended_ok) * p[EMIT_VOICE]^2  — quadratically penalizes EMIT mass when the 6-control safety conjunction trips (B-DHDL-3 nonneg by construction; differentiable analogue of the B-DHDL-4 hard safety override)

corpus.diversity_note: 2400 traces each draw a distinct deterministic LCG perturbation vector (seed 1337 + phi*idx) over phi/retrieve/curiosity/tension/bridge/split/ratchet + safety-control trips + a 45% low-motivation band — diverse physics trajectories, NOT replays of the single §24 run.

structural_finding.title: the §24 talker_should_emit threshold is effectively a binary {EMIT, SILENT} decision; CONTINUE_THINK is a structurally near-empty class
structural_finding.balance_floor_lockout: the §4 phi_ratchet safety control requires phi > ratchet/2; the 8-factor `balance` factor is DEFINED as (phi > ratchet/2 -> 1.0). Therefore whenever safety holds, balance = 1.0 (weight 0.15) — a hard 0.15 score floor.
structural_finding.dynamics_ratelimit_anticoupling: the 8-factor `dynamics` factor = silence/30 and the §4 rate_limit safety control = (silence >= 30) are driven by the SAME variable in opposite senses; whenever rate-limit permits an emit, dynamics = 1.0 (weight 0.10).
structural_finding.consequence: in the safety-OK region the motivation score floor is balance*0.15 + dynamics*0.10 = 0.25, plus a non-trivial relevance contribution — above IM_THRESHOLD = 0.3 for all but a measure-near-zero corner. Only 9 / 48000 records are CONTINUE_THINK. This is a finding ABOUT §24 (valuable for any future re-design of the motivation weighting), not a corpus defect.

training.trainer: train_dhdl.py (numpy-vectorized MLP, explicit hand-coded backprop, no torch autograd)

threshold_distillation_gap.honest_characterization: all 6 gap records are the head FAILING TO PERFECTLY MATCH the §24 threshold (5 EMIT records misclassified SILENT, 1 of the single held-out CONTINUE_THINK record misclassified EMIT). The gap is approximation noise — the head under-fitting near the decision boundary — NOT a decision the threshold could not produce. There is no record where the head exhibits a NEW emission behavior. gap > 0 here means the head is a slightly-imperfect distiller, not an emergent agent.

honest_verdict: DISTILLATION, NOT EMERGENCE. The DH-DL head learns the §24 hand-coded talker_should_emit decision function to 0.99937 accuracy with a threshold-distillation gap of 0.00063 (pure approximation noise). The decision label is a deterministic function of the physics features, so the head can at best match the threshold — and it does, nearly perfectly. This is function approximation (capability), NOT emergence. A learned, differentiable, composable decision-head matching the §24 threshold is a VALUABLE substrate component for future architecture, but it is NOT GOAL emergence. The cycle additionally surfaced a valuable structural finding: the §24 threshold is effectively binary {EMIT, SILENT} (CONTINUE_THINK structurally near-empty). north-star (GOAL.md) unchanged; §15 milestone carries.

blue_falsifier.note: B-DHDL-NOTE — actual trained-head accuracy + threshold-distillation gap + whether the head exhibits any decision the threshold could not = SGD/measurement OUTCOME (B-D-NOTE / B-PHASE-B-NOTE / B-EMERGE-NOTE family, NOT counted 🔵). The battery proves the decision-head MECHANISM is well-formed, NOT that it achieves emergence.
